title: post_api_admin_login_with_valid_and_invalid_passwords
description: Test POST /api/admin/login endpoint with correct and incorrect passwords to verify successful authentication sets the pf_admin session cookie and invalid attempts return appropriate error codes.

title: post_api_admin_logout_clears_session_cookie
description: Test POST /api/admin/logout endpoint to ensure it clears the admin session cookie and returns a successful response when called with an active session.

title: get_api_admin_products_requires_authentication
description: Test GET /api/admin/products endpoint to verify it returns a list of products with images and variants when authenticated, and returns 401 UNAUTHORIZED when no valid session cookie is provided.

title: post_api_admin_products_creates_product_with_validation
description: Test POST /api/admin/products endpoint to create a new product with required fields, images, and variants, validating correct creation and error responses for missing or invalid data.

title: get_api_admin_products_id_fetches_single_product
description: Test GET /api/admin/products/[id] endpoint to fetch a single product by id, verifying successful retrieval and 404 NOT_FOUND for non-existent product ids.

title: put_api_admin_products_id_updates_product_fully
description: Test PUT /api/admin/products/[id] endpoint to fully update a product, replacing images and variants, validating required fields and unique slug, and handling 404 for missing products.

title: patch_api_admin_products_id_updates_featured_and_active_flags
description: Test PATCH /api/admin/products/[id] endpoint to partially update featured and active flags, verifying successful updates and 400 NOTHING_TO_UPDATE error when no valid fields are provided.

title: delete_api_admin_products_id_deletes_product
description: Test DELETE /api/admin/products/[id] endpoint to delete a product and cascade remove images and variants, verifying successful deletion response.

title: get_api_admin_settings_reads_store_settings
description: Test GET /api/admin/settings endpoint: unauthenticated requests must be rejected with 401 by the admin route guard (the storefront reads settings server-side via DB, not via this route); authenticated admin requests must return 200 with the full settings object (shippingMode, shippingFee, currency, storeEmail).

title: put_api_admin_settings_updates_store_settings_with_validation
description: Test PUT /api/admin/settings endpoint to update store-wide settings, validating shipping mode, non-negative shipping fee, 3-letter currency code, and store email, and verifying error responses for invalid inputs.
